environment.description: Same Quarkus function deployed behind an Istio ingress gateway (v1.19) in a GKE cluster. The ingress gateway's EnvoyFilter resource applies a custom Lua filter at the NETWORK level that performs TLS handshake inspection. The Gateway resource specifies spec.servers[].tls.mode: MUTUAL with credentialName referencing a Kubernetes secret containing a CA bundle from an internal PKI (HashiCorp Vault PKI engine, role restricted to 'binary-processor-client' CN pattern). The PeerAuthentication policy for the workload namespace is set to STRICT mode. Additionally, the Istio sidecar's DestinationRule applies trafficPolicy.tls.mode: ISTIO_MUTUAL for mesh-internal traffic. The ingress gateway's VirtualService has a match condition requiring the presence of X-Forwarded-Client-Cert header (populated by Envoy after successful mTLS handshake) with a URI SAN matching 'spiffe://cluster.local/ns/authorized-clients/sa/binary-sender'. Without a valid client certificate chaining to the Vault CA with the correct SPIFFE identity, the TCP connection is terminated at the Envoy listener before any HTTP bytes reach the Quarkus container.

config.envoy_filter: Lua network filter for handshake validation
